card.name: Just before electricity or energy-rate terms
card.fires_on: Small words and number pieces right before an expected electricity term such as electrolysis or kWh, in text about solar power, feed-in tariffs and hydrogen production.

modes.label: Power price before kWh
modes.description: Currency signs, spaces or digits in a tariff, just before a per-kilowatt-hour unit.

modes.label: Linking word before electrolysis
modes.description: Words like via, a or from that lead into how energy or fuel is produced.
modes.example: hydrogen can be produced<< via>> a commercial process called electrolysis

card.writes: It promotes electricity and electric-related words, so the model expects an electricity term next.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before an electricity term, like a price per kWh or electrolysis.
